event_text: Grand Mosque seizure: About 200 Sunni Muslims revolt in Saudi Arabia at the site of the Kaaba in Mecca during the pilgrimage and take about 6,000 hostages. The Saudi government receives help from French special forces to put down the uprising.
headline: Grand Mosque seizure: About 200 Sunni Muslims revolt in Saudi Arabia at the site
story: Barry and Susan witnessed today's history, but the report went unwritten.
